title_sq: Tek Riverside Residence, Shitet Apartament 2+1+2 Me Planimetri Te Rregullt!
description_sq: Tek Riverside Residence, Shitet Apartament 2+1+2 Me Planimetri Te Rregullt! Apartamenti ndodhet ne katin e 3 e orientuar nga Lindja. Prona ka nje planimetri te shfrytezuar maksimalisht dhe shume te rregullt, e perbere nga kuzhina e vecuar, ambient ndenje, 2 dhoma e gjumi ku njera eshte e perbere nga tualeti dhe ballkoni, tualeti kryesor dhe ballkoni me akses nga salloni. Apartamenti eshte ne faze fasade dhe pritet te perfundoje brenda vitit 2027. Zona ne te cilen ndodhet apartamenti eshte nder zonat me te kerkuara, mjaft e qete dhe me te gjitha facilitetet per nje jetese komode.
title_en: At Riverside Residence, 2+1+2 Apartment with Regular Floor Plan for Sale!
description_en: At Riverside Residence, 2+1+2 Apartment with Regular Floor Plan for Sale! The apartment is located on the 3rd floor facing East. The property has a fully utilized and very neat floor plan, consisting of a separate kitchen, living room, 2 bedrooms, one of which consists of a toilet and a balcony, the main toilet and a balcony with access from the living room. The apartment is in the facade stage and is expected to be completed within 2027. The area in which the apartment is located is one of the most sought-after areas, quite quiet and with all the facilities for a comfortable life.
